discovery.reviewer: Root (Claude Code), source review of the turn-6 snapshot plus a disposable scratch build read with the measurement text walker
discovery.scope: The single story route with all ten beats of the approved storyboard; the selected Opening A and Closing A as whole beats; in-beat contact, CV, project and same-story links; the Mosslink page, HTML CV as page and download, the 404, share image, icon, the wording decision archive and the concept archive. Header, chapter and footer navigation are covered by the raw control census, not listed as required links.

eligibility.rationale: The turn-6 closure-time snapshot holds the authored nested site with all ten beats, the custom fixture geometry and the auxiliary pages. This is eligibility for measurement, not a pass.

requiredText: 1 / Prepare Ada Mensah / Embedded firmware Code meets the bench. I’m Ada Mensah. I’m looking for embedded firmware roles involving physical devices. For Mosslink, an environmental sensor, I wrote the firmware, scheduled the power states and built the bring-up fixture. How does a firmware decision become something you can check? Inspect the fixture ↓ Evidence & contact Download HTML CV Firmware is the code that controls a physical device’s operation. Bring-up means checking a new board’s basic operation.

5 / Record The claim follows the observation. A firmware decision needs a physical observation. An estimate and an observed run support different claims. That is the lesson I want to bring to firmware work involving physical devices. A current trace showed the radio staying awake after a failed transmission. No cause, fix, timing or later resolution is confirmed. No trace file is available to publish. ada@example.com ↗ View / print CV Download HTML CV ↓ Read the Mosslink project Back to the start ↑
